title: VQ-LIC: Shared Vector-Quantized Learned Image Compression on a Resource-Constrained FPGA
summary: Learned image compression (LIC) is hard to deploy on severely resource-constrained FPGAs, since how fast it actually runs depends not just on arithmetic count, but also on memory traffic, imbalance between different operations, and how the hardware batches its work.
